final_energy_ry.description: DFT total energy from QE BFGS relaxation.

final_energy_ev.description: DFT total energy in eV (= final_energy_ry × 13.6057).

delta_e_ry.description: Energy relative to parent primary structure (NaN for primary rows).

delta_e_ev.description: delta_e_ry in eV (NaN for primary rows).

delta_e_meV.description: delta_e_ry in meV (NaN for primary rows).

energy_per_atom_ry.description: Total energy divided by number of atoms. Partially normalises for system size, but cross-system comparison is still not physically meaningful (different stoichiometries).

n_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the relaxed structure.

ionic_steps.description: BFGS geometry optimization steps to convergence. Proxy for relaxation difficulty.

scf_iterations_total.description: Total SCF electronic iterations across all ionic steps.

max_force_ry_per_bohr.description: Maximum residual force at end of relaxation (QE-reported).

z_metal.description: Atomic number of the central transition metal (24=Cr, 26=Fe, 28=Ni).

n_ligands.description: Number of atoms within 2.5 Å of the metal center.

ml_mean_angstrom.description: Mean metal–ligand bond length (direct M-C or M-ring bond).

ml_std_angstrom.description: Standard deviation of M-L bond lengths. 0 for perfect symmetry.

lml_angle_mean_deg.description: Mean L-M-L angle over all ligand pairs. 90° for perfect Oh/Td; varies for perturbed geometries.

lml_angle_std_deg.description: Standard deviation of L-M-L angles. 0 for perfect symmetry.

co_mean_angstrom.description: Mean C–O bond length for carbonyl ligands. NaN for ferrocene.

co_std_angstrom.description: Standard deviation of C-O bond lengths. NaN for ferrocene.

cm_eig_00.description: Coulomb matrix eigenvalue 0 (sorted by descending |value|). Zero-padded for structures with fewer than 21 atoms.
